Vitamin D, usually in the form of calcitriol, may be used in the treatment of osteoporosis (see below). In established postmenopausal osteoporosis, calcitriol 0.25 micrograms twice daily is recommended. Vita- min D and calcium supplements are often given as ad- juncts to other therapies in osteoporosis. Calcitriol has been used in the management of psoria- sis (see below).
